title: Istanbul vs Cairo: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Istanbul for ease, food, and comfort. Cairo for the Pyramids, ancient history, and budget travel. Do both if connecting Middle East with East Africa.

categories.name: Food & Dining
categories.summary: Turkish cuisine is world-class. Istanbul wins on food variety, quality, and consistency at every price point.

categories.name: Historical Sites
categories.summary: Cairo has the Pyramids (unmatched). Istanbul has Hagia Sophia, Topkapi, and 2,500 years of layered history.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Cairo is 40-50% cheaper. $40-70/day vs $70-120/day in Istanbul.

categories.name: Transit
categories.summary: Istanbul's tram/metro/ferry combo beats Cairo's Uber-dependent, traffic-choked system.

categories.name: Safety
categories.summary: Istanbul is easier and lower-hassle. Cairo has physical safety but persistent tourist scams.

categories.name: Day Trips
categories.summary: Cairo unlocks Luxor, Alexandria, Sinai. Istanbul offers Princes' Islands and Bursa.

categories.name: Best Time to Visit
categories.summary: Istanbul is viable year-round. Cairo is only comfortable October-April; summer is brutal.

categories.name: Nightlife
categories.summary: Istanbul has a thriving rooftop bar and club scene. Cairo is more limited.

faq.question: Is Istanbul or Cairo better for first-time visitors?
faq.answer: Istanbul. Safer, easier, better food, more walkable. Cairo if the Pyramids are your primary goal.

faq.question: Is Cairo or Istanbul cheaper?
faq.answer: Cairo is 40-50% cheaper day-to-day. $40-70/day vs $70-120 in Istanbul.

faq.question: Can you visit both Istanbul and Cairo on one trip?
faq.answer: Yes. Flights take ~2.5 hours and run daily. A popular route: Istanbul 4-5 days → fly to Cairo → continue to East Africa.
